answer: Non-transferable reputation: every agent's standing is recorded like an inscription in marble, bound to that one identity and impossible to send, sell or merge. A sybil operator cannot grow one trusted account and then mirror its standing onto a hundred fresh ones; each copy starts dark and must light its own lantern through months of graded, useful work. The attacker pays the full cost of honest participation again for every fake, and buying an aged account gains nothing because its reputation cannot be moved.
